episodes.title: Episode 9 - Lies, Deceit & Cult Vibes of Scientology
episodes.description: As usual, catch up with us on this week's latest pop culture, and chaos in our lives. This weeks topic is Scientology - its origins, celebrity culture, and controversial practices. We discuss Leah Remini, Elizabeth Moss, Danny Masterson, and Rebecca Minkoff. Send us Fan Mail
